observations: Blue PS4 Slim console wrapped in plastic wrap.
Gold/white PlayStation symbols (triangle, circle, cross, square) on the top cover.
Watermark 'THE GAME GUY VENTURES' present on all photos.
The console design matches the 'Days of Play' 2018 Limited Edition.
No photos of the rear ports, bottom, or side profiles.

identity.model: PlayStation 4 Slim Days of Play Edition

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the blue limited edition console.

claims.claim: 10 latest games. Such as FIFA and PES 2027
claims.evidence: No games are shown in photos. Note: PES 2027 does not exist.
Warranty seals on the rear are not visible.
The camo controller in photo 1 is a standard variant, not the specific gold-symbol blue controller that originally came with this edition.

risks.risk: Console has been opened or repaired.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the warranty seals on the rear of the console.

risks.risk: Games are non-existent, digital-only, or the console is jailbroken.
risks.proof: Photo of physical game discs or a video of the system storage/library screen.
Photo of the model sticker on the back of the controller.
Video of the console running a demanding game (e.g., FIFA) for several minutes.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the console showing the ports and the intact warranty seals.
Photo of the 10 game discs or the console screen showing the game library.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned.
Photo of the back of the controller.
response.reason: The seller claims to have 'PES 2027', a game that does not exist, which makes the other claims suspect. Additionally, the controller shown is not the original matching unit for this limited edition console, and there is no proof of the games or the console's internal state.
